facts.fact: TVOD is transactional video on demand, where viewers pay for individual titles either as a short-term rental or permanent purchase rather than a recurring subscription.
facts.quote: Under this model, viewers pay for individual pieces of content on a title-by-title basis—either as a short-term rental or a permanent digital purchase

facts.fact: TVOD carries essentially no ad inventory because consumers pay directly for content, so TVOD viewing is ad-free.
facts.quote: For advertisers, TVOD carries essentially no ad inventory. Because consumers pay directly for the content, TVOD viewing is ad-free.

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's hypothetical example, a viewer capped at three impressions on each of three separate services could be shown the same commercial nine times in one evening.
facts.quote: A viewer might be capped at three impressions on one service, three on another, and three on a third—resulting in a single consumer seeing the exact same commercial nine times in one evening.
